summary: @servicetitan/unit-tests preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime tarball from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped math_init.js file at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle using a rotated string array (WV8StW shift routine) and dictionary-encoded literals, with no source map and no documented purpose. The package advertises itself as a ts-mockito helper and its main dist/index.js only re-exports ts-mockito plus a small IoC container helper — none of which requires a Bun runtime or a large obfuscated blob. The alternate-runtime pattern (fetch Bun purely to execute a Bun-only payload) causes the payload to run on every installer's host during `npm install` while evading Node-based inspection. The @servicetitan scope combined with contents unrelated to the advertised purpose is consistent with scoped-package impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
